caption: The drawing features a rectangular piece of fabric that is decorated with floral and leaf patterns. The background is shaded light gray, while the designs are prominently outlined and colored in green and pink-red. Large, stylized green leaves and red flowers dominate the pattern, with a central symmetrical flower composed of pointed red petals with a white outline and a green stem. Smaller red circular shapes are interspersed among the leaves and flowers. On the right side of the fabric, there is a green vine that curves, with smaller green leaves and several upward-facing red flowers attached. At the bottom right of the main piece, there is a semicircular design in green filled with a pink-red curving line. Below the main fabric illustration, there is a smaller rectangular section that appears to be an enlarged detail from the main design, showing part of a red flower, three red dots, and a green leaf against the same crosshatched gray background. The artist's name "E. Hastings" is written in small green letters near the lower left of the image.
title: Quilt
